answer: A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The karst multiplier is published, charged in whisper, and meadow lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 5 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 534 identities would post 1448 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
